verdict.rationale: incident.io documents a postmortem workflow: a post-incident flow, policies and list views for tracking completion, plus AI-generated first drafts, inline review suggestions and section redrafting. Its auto-generated timeline is also documented, but nothing explicitly ties postmortem drafts to it. Missing for 10: documented postmortem templates, an explicit draft-from-timeline mechanism, a human review/approval step, a postmortem publication/sharing step, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
